findings.evidence: Extension.lean:28; downstream refs are only `P.order`/`P.ordered`/lemmas (Basic.lean:41,92), none unfolding a body.
findings.fix: Replace `@[expose] public section` with `public section`. Add `@[expose]` back only to a specific def if the build shows a downstream consumer must unfold it; otherwise add the missing characteristic lemma (e.g. `mem_cone`) and keep the body hidden.
findings.issue: `@[expose] public section` exposes the bodies of `cone`, `order`, and `sumSq` (and, pointlessly, all theorem proofs). No importing module unfolds these: OrderedSubfield.lean/Basic.lean use only `order`, `isStrictOrderedRing`, `nonneg_iff`, `exists_linearOrder` by name, and the in-file defeq proof of `nonneg_iff` does not require cross-module exposure.

findings.evidence: OrderedSubfield.lean:17; grep of Basic.lean shows only by-name references to `P.order`/`P.ordered` etc.
findings.fix: Drop the `@[expose]` from the section; expose individually only any def a consumer provably unfolds, keeping the rest opaque behind their existing lemmas.
findings.issue: Same blanket `@[expose] public section` exposes bodies of `preordering`, `order`, `image`, `base`. Basic.lean consumes `OrderedSubfield` only via `order`, `ordered`, `nonneg_iff`, `base_strictMono`, `mem_of_maximal`, `exists_maximal`, `isRealClosed`, `exists_intermediateField` — never unfolding a def body.

summary: The characteristic API and privacy are in good shape, but two files use a blanket `@[expose] public section` that exposes definition bodies (cone, order, sumSq, preordering, image, base) no importing module needs to unfold, over-locking the implementation into the public interface.
